about: What the base desktop (platform plus Orpheus or Kairos) may cost at rest, checked by bin/ryoku-dev-perf-baseline --budget. The numbers are measurements, not limits: each limit is the number plus the margins. docs/performance.md, 'The budget gate', explains every entry and how to update it.

reference.machine: Hyperion lab: systemd-nspawn, nested niri at 1920x1080 on headless Weston, AMD iGPU, still 4K wallpaper (rices/default/wall.webp)
reference.scenario: idle: empty workspace, no music, nothing open, 120 s settle, 60 s window
reference.measured: 2026-11-07: Hyperion step 2 lab runs (Orpheus, Orpheus after three reloads, Kairos); session-daemons read in the lab the same day

shell-daemon.source: PSS and CPU from the lab (18.0 to 18.5 MB); wakeups from the bare-metal at-rest run in docs/performance.md

lab.why: in the container the daemon's input watch falls back to a 2 s poll (34 to 44 wakeups/s measured)

wm-provider.source: the daemon's and Ryogami's ryoku-wm-niri watch, 6.3 to 6.7 MB together

wallpaper.source: ryogami daemon with a still wallpaper, 13.3 to 14.3 MB

session-daemons.source: ryoku-bt-agent (sh, tail -f /dev/null, bluetoothctl --agent); tail polls /dev/null once a second

shell-ui.source: qs -c shell: 292 to 299 MB PSS, 238 to 242 MB VRAM plus GTT, 8.2 to 8.5 wakeups/s; the one launch a minute then (the recorder's gsr-cli poll) is gone
